hints.title: Compare adjacent words
hints.body: Only adjacent pairs matter. Find the first character where two neighboring words differ; that pair gives one alphabet constraint.

hints.title: Reject bad prefixes
hints.body: If no differing character is found and the first word is longer than the second, the list is impossible. Otherwise the shorter prefix case is fine.

hints.title: Order the letters
hints.body: The constraints form a directed graph on letters. A valid alphabet is a topological order. If the graph has a cycle, return an empty string.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
collect every distinct letter
graph = empty, indegree = 0 for each letter
for each adjacent pair (a, b):
    find first differing position i
    if no differing position:
        if length(a) > length(b): return ""
    else add edge a[i] -> b[i]
use a min-heap of letters with indegree 0
repeatedly take the smallest letter, append it, and lower its neighbors' indegrees
if the result does not contain every letter: return ""
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete implementation.
